stem: An electronics testing study measures the battery life (hours) for a sample of 20 smartphone models. The sample mean is 23.4 hours with a sample standard deviation of 7.0 hours. Assuming the data are approximately normally distributed, estimate the true population mean and provide a 95% confidence interval.

ground_truth.answer: Population mean ≈ 23.4 hours. 95% CI = [20.1, 26.7]. Point estimate: 23.4 hours.

common_failure_modes: Using z-critical value instead of t-critical for small samples
Not reporting the confidence interval alongside the point estimate
